metaDescription: Abadan & Co. — corporate training in Kazakhstan since 2015: in person, online and ibirAi. 360+ companies, 50,000+ people trained, 200+ experts.
title: We develop people. We grow results. Through technology.
lead: Abadan & Co. is a corporate training company based in Kazakhstan. We combine in-person training built around clients’ real business cases with online learning and mobile training through ibirAi.

founder.title: A word from the founder
founder.name: Gani Abadan
founder.photoAlt: Gani Abadan, founder of Abadan & Co.
founder.quote: We don't “run trainings” — we solve business problems by developing teams.
founder.p1: My name is Gani Abadan, and I am the founder and senior partner of Abadan & Company. Over more than ten years in corporate training we have grown from a small training centre into one of Kazakhstan's leading people-development companies.
founder.p2: I am writing to you personally because I know the challenges you face every day: finding qualified trainers, justifying training budgets to management, measuring the real return on investing in people. I want to tell you why more than 360 companies have already chosen us as their partner.
founder.p3: Every programme we run is 80% practice on your company's real cases. Not abstract theory, but concrete skills your people apply the very next day.
founder.p4: Over the years we have built a pool of more than 200 practising experts across a wide range of fields — from oil and gas and industrial safety to HR management and artificial intelligence.
founder.p5: I personally guarantee the quality of every programme. If the result does not meet your expectations, we will run a repeat session at our own expense.

advTitle: What exactly we give our partners

adv.d: We send you a commercial proposal on the day you contact us and can launch the training within three days. No lengthy approval process.
The programme is built on the company's real tasks and tied to its metrics.
We match a trainer to your industry and context: oil and gas, finance, law, HR, leadership, AI.
Assignments, review and support after the training, so the skill sticks at work.

adv.t: Training for groups as small as two
adv.d: No need to gather a large group. Every participant gets personal feedback.

adv.t: We take care of the paperwork and logistics
adv.d: We provide the completion documents on the last day of training. We arrange accommodation and transport for participants travelling from other regions.

pgtLead: The three pillars of our approach to corporate training.

pgt.d: A focus on developing people: HR competencies, soft skills, leadership, teamwork. A company grows when each employee grows.
Training aimed at business metrics. We don't just run trainings — we work for real change in how teams operate.
A hybrid format: in-person training, online courses and learning on the phone through the ibirAi platform.

formats.d: Live learning with practice on real cases: in Almaty and on site at your facility.
Webinars and courses for distributed teams.
A messenger-based safety training platform for frontline workers, with understanding verified for every employee. A separate product with its own website.

ctaLead: Tell us about your task — we will prepare a commercial proposal the same day.
